fact: At an Oran study day the director general at the Interior ministry in charge of generalising the Référentiel national d'adressage said 1.5 million official unified geolocatable addresses have been counted, generalisation has so far covered 12 wilayas with 13 more in the state budget, and the national plan covers all 69 wilayas by 2030.
title: في يوم دراسي بوهران: الكشف عن إحصاء 1.5 مليون عنوان رسمي موحد قابل للتحديد الجيومكاني
